summary: Frontend-only testing of Hi Tours homepage covering all 11 review-requested items at desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). 14/14 functional checks passed: (1) announcement bar dismiss persists across reload via sessionStorage; (2) no nav-login element in header, desktop-nav shows Destinations/Trip types/Activities/Deals/About us and Expert advice; (3) hero is a full-bleed <video data-testid='hero-collage'> with transparent site-header overlay and white HI TOURS logo; (4) trust-bar shows Google '4.7 / 3,200+ Google reviews' and Tripadvisor '4.9 / 2,100+ Tripadvisor reviews'; (5) showcase tabs centered, Iceland tab click switches active card, stats read '14 days / 9 activities / 6 hotels / 4 transfers' (no stops/rental car); (6) hero-search-input opens suggestions panel with 58 destinations sorted alphabetically each with a thumbnail img; clicking hero-search-suggestion-egypt navigates to /afrika/aegypten, clicking hero-search-suggestion-asia navigates to /asien; (7) testimonials section has 7 cards with brand-stars and testimonial-avatar circles, no Trustpilot logo/text; (8) footer shows 5 VISIBLE social icons (Facebook/Instagram/LinkedIn/YouTube/Spotify) with no Trustpilot in footer-badges; (9) mobile hamburger opens full-screen mobile-menu with close button and Destinations accordion expands to 19 sub-items, tapping Egypt navigates to /afrika/aegypten and Asia to /asien; (10) no horizontal overflow at 390px (scrollWidth=clientWidth=390) and all key sections render on mobile. Zero console errors or warnings on desktop and mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: Footer.jsx renders 10 elements with data-testid='footer-social' in the DOM (5 visible + 5 hidden), because the component appears to render two responsive variants (mobile + desktop) that share the same testid. Visually only 5 are shown per viewport so the user-facing requirement is met, but for testability the duplicate testid is not ideal — consider suffixing (footer-social-desktop / footer-social-mobile) or conditionally rendering one variant per viewport.
Announcement banner uses sessionStorage as required — persistence verified across reload in the same session.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (14/14 checks pass; 1 minor code-quality note on duplicate testid)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Homepage stable. Verified counts: search suggestions=58 (alphabetical, with images), showcase stats=days/activities/hotels/transfers (no stops/rental), testimonials cards=7, visible footer socials=5, mobile Destinations sub-items=19. Regression search navigations: Egypt->/afrika/aegypten, Asia->/asien work on both desktop and mobile. Console clean.
